text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature hasn't shown up for training. Worried, I go looking for her.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Gaaah! I know it happens every time, but I can't wait for that catchphrase!

text_block_list.name: Appliance Store Owner
text_block_list.text: You know it, Natie! That's the best part of The C-Team.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I find Nice Nature intently watching a show on a display TV at the appliance store.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh! There's the van! Here it comes! Is he gonna take out his ciga—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wha—Trainer! What are you doing here?
choice_data_list: …I pity the fool who's not wearing their tracksuit!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haha, that sounds like something they would say in the show. But why are you talking about track…suits…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: R-roger that! I'll do better from now on…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I love it when a plan comes together! …Next time, hopefully.
